name: neighbourhood_id_orphans
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits p WHERE p.neighbourhood_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM neighbourhoods n WHERE n.id = p.neighbourhood_id)

name: negative_neighbourhood_ids
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE neighbourhood_id < 0

name: linked_permit_outside_its_own_neighbourhood
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits p JOIN neighbourhoods n ON n.id = p.neighbourhood_id WHERE p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND n.geom IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_Contains(n.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p.longitude::float, p.latitude::float), 4326))

name: stamped_permits_with_null_coordinates
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE neighbourhood_id IS NOT NULL AND (latitude IS NULL OR longitude IS NULL)

name: neighbourhood_id_unreachable_no_coords
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits p WHERE p.neighbourhood_id IS NULL AND (p.latitude IS NULL OR p.longitude IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM permit_parcels pp JOIN parcels pa ON pa.id = pp.parcel_id WHERE pp.permit_num = p.permit_num AND pp.revision_num = p.revision_num AND pa.geometry IS NOT NULL)

name: neighbourhoods_geom_corpus
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM neighbourhoods WHERE geom IS NOT NULL

name: permits_linked_cumulative
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE neighbourhood_id IS NOT NULL

name: permits_eligible_scope
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM permits WHERE neighbourhood_id IS NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
